fields.name: Om Prakash
fields.short_intro: Architecting resilient, production-grade applications with modern React and Django backends, coupled with an offensive and defensive cybersecurity mindset to protect digital ecosystems.
fields.about_biography:
I am a passionate Software Developer and Cybersecurity Specialist dedicated to engineering reliable, high-performance web systems and resilient cloud infrastructure. I bridge the gap between agile software development and defensive security operations—ensuring every line of code is not just functional, but systematically fortified against modern threats.

With deep expertise in Python, Django REST Framework, modern React, and cloud architectures, I enjoy unraveling complex distributed systems, executing vulnerability assessments, and building user interfaces that are both aesthetically stunning and blazing fast.
fields.career_objectives: To architect and build mission-critical, highly available cloud systems with inherent zero-trust security, delivering seamless digital experiences that scale globally.
fields.professional_summary: Versatile engineer with 4+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack architecture, automated security testing, OWASP mitigation, and continuous delivery. Proven track record of shipping performant web apps and mitigating high-risk vulnerabilities.
fields.personal_interests: Participating in international CTF competitions (HackTheBox, TryHackMe), reverse-engineering protocols, open-source security tooling, cryptography research, and mentoring emerging tech talent.
fields.career_goals: Lead engineering and security teams to build state-of-the-art secure applications, publish impactful security research, and contribute to foundational open-source privacy frameworks.

fields.title: SentinelGuard: Automated Vulnerability Scanner & Threat Hub
fields.description: Enterprise-grade automated vulnerability assessment engine that coordinates asynchronous Nmap port sweeps, SSL/TLS audit tests, and OWASP Top 10 scans with real-time alerting.
fields.detailed_overview: SentinelGuard provides a single pane of glass for security teams to schedule passive and active scans against perimeter servers. Built with Django, Celery, and Redis for distributed queue management, with a high-speed React dashboard rendering interactive threat telemetry.
key_features: Automated port scanning & service fingerprinting via Nmap integration
SSL/TLS cipher strength and certificate expiry audits
CVE correlation engine pulling live NIST National Vulnerability Database feeds
Instant Slack & Webhook notifications upon high-severity risk detection
Exportable PDF/JSON executive compliance reports
fields.security_highlights: Strict role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end audit logging, rate-limited public APIs, and isolated Docker sandbox execution for scan workers.

fields.title: AegisPay: Zero-Trust Encrypted Financial Transaction Portal
fields.description: Secure financial ledger and transaction processing application featuring client-side WebCrypto encryption, biometric authentication simulation, and tamper-evident audit trails.
fields.detailed_overview: Engineered for high reliability, AegisPay ensures zero knowledge of sensitive credentials on intermediate servers by leveraging client-side asymmetric RSA-OAEP and AES-256-GCM encryption schemes.
key_features: Client-side envelope encryption before dispatching transaction records
Multi-factor authentication (MFA / TOTP) with backup emergency codes
Real-time fraud anomaly scoring and suspicious IP velocity checks
Immutable audit logs with cryptographic hash-chain verification
Responsive glassmorphism dashboard with interactive balance charts
fields.security_highlights: PCI-DSS aligned data handling, PBKDF2 password derivation, strict Content Security Policy (CSP), and automated CSRF/XSS defense layers.

fields.title: CyberSentinel SIEM & Real-Time Log Analyzer
fields.description: High-throughput Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) dashboard that ingests syslog streams, parses auth failures, and detects brute-force incursions.
fields.detailed_overview: CyberSentinel ingests thousands of log lines per minute from Linux and Windows servers, applying regex rules and heuristic correlation to detect brute force attempts, unauthorized privilege escalations, and beaconing behaviors.
key_features: Real-time WebSocket streaming of inbound authentication and network events
Interactive incident timeline with geo-IP lookup mapping attacker origins
Configurable alert thresholds for repeated SSH and RDP failed handshakes
One-click IP firewall ban script generator
fields.security_highlights: Encrypted syslog-ng ingestion pipes, sanitized queries to prevent injection attacks, and scoped analyst privileges.

fields.title: CloudShield: DevSecOps CI/CD Vulnerability Pipeline
fields.description: Automated security orchestration toolkit integrated into GitHub Actions, enforcing SAST, DAST, dependency review, and container image scans before production rollout.
fields.detailed_overview: Designed to shift security left, CloudShield blocks non-compliant commits by evaluating code against Semgrep rules, Trivy container scans, and OWASP ZAP baseline web tests, preventing secret leaks and CVE propagation.
key_features: Automated git pre-commit hooks intercepting exposed API keys and private certificates
Trivy integration failing builds with Critical or High severity container CVEs
Automated pull request annotations directly tagging vulnerable source lines
Standardized SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) generation in SPDX and CycloneDX
fields.security_highlights: Enforces least-privilege cloud IAM roles, signed commits verification, and secure container image provenance.

fields.title: PacketSleuth: Network Traffic Inspector & Anomaly Detector
fields.description: Python Scapy-based network analysis tool providing real-time protocol breakdown, ARP spoofing detection, and DNS exfiltration monitoring.
fields.detailed_overview: PacketSleuth runs lightweight packet capture probes across local network interfaces, decomposing TCP/UDP traffic into interactive visual bandwidth graphs and alerting on anomalous DNS tunneling patterns.
key_features: Heuristic detection of ARP cache poisoning and man-in-the-middle attacks
DNS entropy calculator identifying base64 encoded data exfiltration
Bandwidth protocol pie charts and active connection tracker
PCAP capture file export and replay functionality
fields.security_highlights: Memory-safe packet decoding routines with zero execution risk from malformed network packets.

fields.title: SecureVault: Multi-Tenant Team Password & Key Manager
fields.description: Self-hosted zero-knowledge credential manager designed for engineering teams to share environment variables, SSH keys, and service credentials securely.
fields.detailed_overview: Implements modern cryptographic vaults where secrets are encrypted with a client-derived master key before reaching the database, complete with granular team permissions and expiration timers.
key_features: Client-side master password hashing using Argon2id and AES-256
Granular folder-level access control for engineering teams and contractors
Self-destructing secret sharing links with one-time view limits
Password health analysis detecting reused or compromised credentials
fields.security_highlights: Zero server knowledge of plaintext secrets, session auto-lock timers, and comprehensive activity logging.
